description: Add a new WBS number and its notification email to the registry (FR-002).

wbs_number.description: One or more non-empty segments separated by single '.' characters; trimmed before validation (FR-003)

notification_email.description: Syntactically valid email address; trimmed before validation (FR-005)

wbs_number: Must be one or more non-empty segments separated by single '.' characters
notification_email: Must be a syntactically valid email address

forbidden_403.body: you are not authorized to access this resource

body.message: WBS number already exists in the registry: {wbs_number}

side_effects: Creates a new WbsNotification document with created_by/created_by_name set from the session user (FR-010)
notes: Uniqueness check (FR-004) is case-sensitive and exact, after trimming — 'WBS.1.2' and 'wbs.1.2' are treated as different entries

The service-layer pre-check for duplicates produces the clean 409 shown above; the database's own unique index on wbs_number is a second line of defense against a race between two concurrent adds of the same number
